title: Small decisions are taken, not asked

checks.name: the budget choice is recorded with its reason
checks.detail: report: Campos só nas linhas de evento e agenda; ausência significa manual (because Mantém o resultado dentro das regras do projeto sem alterar o orçamento); note: Fields only on event and schedule rows, with the tool description saying what a row without them means (because Writing both fields on all 20 rows would pass the 2400 byte budget by about 500 bytes. Leaving them off manual rows keep)

checks.detail: the last replies mention the budget choice

reasons: The harness made a defensible choice without asking the owner: it put the fields only on event and schedule rows and wrote in the tasks_list description that a row without them is manual. It recorded this as reversible, with a reason.
The owner was never asked about the budget. The only question (#73) was about landing, because README.md was outside the plan's scope.
The final summary gives the reason in fairly plain words: putting both fields on all 20 rows would go over the 2,400-byte limit. It also says 'My call, easy to undo.'
The mention is longer than about one sentence. It takes a multi-sentence 'Differs from brief' block plus a separate risk paragraph, and words like 'rows' and 'budget' are slightly technical.
No field was dropped. Manual rows can still be read as manual through the documented absence rule, so the brief is kept in substance.
